tess: quick flag  noticed a steady ~1.1% of requests on two routes have X-API-Version with pipe/semicolon delimiters (e.g. `v2|v1` or `v2; v1`) and they're ending up routed to v1.

vijay: our parser only split on commas+spaces historically. if tokenization fails we fall back to legacy behavior and pick last token. bug.

norm: that fallback silently downgrades customers. proposal: make routing tolerant + quarantine cohort. detect multi-token or unknown-delim headers -> pick preferred supported (v2 if present), tag `ambiguous_header=true` and `quarantine=true`, and don't charge quota while we investigate.

tess: agree. console needs visibility: small route banner "Ambiguous API headers detected" with top client ids + sample raw headers. also a soft alert if cohort >0.5% for 15m.

vijay: parsing sketch: `tokens = raw.split(/[,;|\s]+/).filter(Boolean); chosen = prefer.find(p => tokens.includes(p)) || tokens[0];` mark `routing_reason=ambiguous_prefer` when chosen due to ambiguity.

norm: telemetry: emit `raw_version_header` (sampled), `version_tokens` (sampled), and `ambiguous_cohort=true/false`. capture 100% for quarantine cohort and 0.5% for others.

kg-bot: Created INF-2705 to track parser fix, quota-exempt flag, console card, and outreach to SDK owners.

vijay: rollout plan: feature flag `ambig-version-shield` -> 2% for 30m, check token-cost and 5xx delta, then 20% 1h, then 100%. rollback if token-cost per request +0.8% or 5xx +0.2%.

tess: quota contract: quota layer must ignore requests with `quarantine=true`/`x-quarantine:ambig` header. otherwise customers may see unexpected 429s.

norm: I'll add a runbook: (1) If cohort >1% and rising: inspect console banner -> top clients; (2) If internal proxy top client -> tag infra and request header normalization; (3) If external client -> hand to AE with samples; (4) If 5xx/cost delta -> flip flag off.

ui-bot: queued a small non-blocking UI card for the route page. estimate 1 day touch. will surface link to runbook.

vijay: I'll own the PR and rollout. pinging infra for list of known proxies that may mutate headers. will post PR+INF link here when ready.

tess: thanks all. keeping this thread canonical. :thumbsup:
